name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-control-channel
description: Shared bounded control-channel for PTC and SSH execution: length-prefixed JSON frames with byte bounds and queued-write backpressure, the orthogonal process-outcome failure vocabulary, the lifecycle state machine separating result, cancellation, closure, quiescence, and cleanup, and the optional stream-attached transport with caller cancellation, deadlines, and close-grace escalation
